title: NotOverFormat
description: A `not` whose inner schema states nothing but a format. Whether that inner schema admits every value is the dialect's answer and not the schema's: where format annotates it admits everything and the negation forbids everything, and where format asserts it admits only the non-conforming strings and the negation forbids exactly the conforming ones. Read as accept-all on both, the negation refused every document under assertion -- including the numbers `format` never speaks about.

notEmailInItems.$comment: The same at an element, which reaches the predicate by a different route.

formatBranches.$comment: The other direction, through countBooleanSchemas: a oneOf whose branches both accept every value matches twice and so matches nothing, which is what makes reading a format branch as accept-all a rejection rather than a missing check. Where format annotates, both branches really do accept everything and the oneOf really is empty; where it asserts, "a@b.com" satisfies the first alone.
